\begin{document}
The dipole $\mathbf{d}$ couples to the field $\mathbf{e}$ through $\mathbf{d}\cdot\mathbf{e}$.
Its square, which enters the second-order energy shift, is
\begin{equation}
\left(\mathbf{d}\cdot\mathbf{e}\right)^2 = \mathbf{d}^2\,\mathbf{e}^2 .
\label{eq:dd}
\end{equation}
